newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Prices of petroleum products up in Ivory Coast. [CORRECTED 19:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Prices of petroleum products up in Ivory Coast. [CORRECTED 19:45 GMT]

text.p: Prices of petroleum products rose by nearly five percent (corrects from 9.5 percent) on Monday after a government decree liberalising the sector came into effect.
Under the measure announced on September 12, government control of prices of oil products ended on Sunday night.
On Monday a litre of super was posted at a maximum 414 CFA francs compared with 395 CFA the previous day, while regular petrol climbed from 365 CFA a litre to 377 CFA.
Diesel was posted at a maximum 276 CFA a litre from 270 CFA while kerosine moved up to 215 CFA from 210 CFA a litre.
The government said its objective was to encourage competition and bring down prices in the long term.
